public.title: Unsquash Object
public.description: Reconstruct an object from a flat map whose keys are nonempty dot-delimited paths of ASCII-letter segments. Paths have at most 6 segments, are distinct and never prefix each other. Leaf values are JSON scalars or arrays. There are at most 30 paths and 100 total leaf nodes. Return the nested object; object key order is irrelevant. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
